screens.content: From Monday to Wednesday, Sam Rivera follows the lake path, crosses Market Lane, and catches the 07:40 bus. Even when the stop is busy, he checks the route number before boarding and reaches City Parks with time to unlock the tool shed. On Tuesday, rain makes the path slippery, so Sam takes the covered walkway and arrives a few minutes early.
